description: Check real-time room availability and exact total price for a stay at Yasha Hotel. Returns, per room type: available (boolean), nights, total_cents (exact stay total in euro cents, before extras/breakfast/promo), avg_night_cents and a per-night price breakdown. Direct rates are about 10% below Booking.com/Expedia for the same rooms and dates. Constraints: dates YYYY-MM-DD, checkin < checkout, checkin not in the past, maximum 30 nights.

checkin.description: Arrival date YYYY-MM-DD (check-in from 13:00, front desk 24/7)

name: check_availability
